title: DJI Neo live stream: Instagram, TikTok and YouTube setup (2026)
description: How to live stream a DJI Neo: which control mode works (phone, RC-N3, goggles), RTMP in DJI Fly, and going live on Instagram, TikTok or YouTube with DJI Live Bridge.
h1: How to live stream a DJI Neo
lead: The DJI Neo streams through DJI Fly's RTMP option, like DJI's bigger drones. The catch is the way you fly it: when the phone controls the Neo directly over Wi-Fi, that Wi-Fi is taken by the drone. Fly with the RC-N3 (or goggles cabled to the phone) and the phone is free to send the stream to DJI Live Bridge on your computer, which takes it on to Instagram, TikTok, YouTube or several platforms at once.
summary: The Neo streams from DJI Fly on your phone: GO FLY → ••• → Transmission → Live Streaming Platforms → RTMP.
Use the RC-N3: the phone is connected to the controller by cable, so its Wi-Fi can join the computer's network.
In phone-only mode the phone's Wi-Fi is connected to the Neo itself, so it usually cannot reach a computer.
With goggles, cable them to the phone running DJI Fly and stream from there.
DJI Live Bridge turns the stream into vertical 1080×1920 for Instagram and TikTok, and reaches Instagram over RTMPS.

sections.h2: Which Neo control mode can stream?

blocks.p: The Neo can be flown three ways, and that decides how the stream leaves the phone. In every case DJI Fly on the phone does the streaming; DJI Live Bridge on the computer receives it.

head: How you fly
Streams to a computer?
Why
rows: The phone's Wi-Fi is connected to the Neo, so it is not on the computer's network.
The phone talks to the controller by cable; its Wi-Fi joins the same network as the computer.
Goggles + phone on a USB-C cable
DJI Fly on the phone shows the goggles' live view and can stream it.

blocks.note: Some Android phones can run their own hotspot while connected to a Wi-Fi network. If yours can, the computer could join that hotspot in phone-only mode — we have not tested it, so treat it as an experiment.

sections.h2: Set up the Neo live stream with the RC-N3

steps.t: Connect the phone to the RC-N3
steps.d: Fly the Neo with the RC-N3 as usual, phone attached by cable, DJI Fly open.

steps.t: Join phone and computer to one network
steps.d: Connect the phone's Wi-Fi and the computer to the same Wi-Fi. In the field, turn on a second phone's hotspot or a travel router and join both to it.
Install DJI Live Bridge on a Mac or Windows PC. It shows an address like rtmp://192.168.1.20:1935/drone.

steps.t: Enter the address in DJI Fly
steps.d: GO FLY → ••• → Transmission → Live Streaming Platforms → RTMP, type the address and start. The preview appears in the app.
Add Instagram, TikTok, YouTube or any RTMP server, keep Vertical 9:16 for Instagram and TikTok, and press START LIVE.

blocks.alt: The Go live tab of DJI Live Bridge with the RTMP address for DJI Fly, the destinations and the START LIVE button.

blocks.note: More detail on the DJI Fly side, networks and firewalls is in the DJI Fly RTMP guide.

list: An Android phone streams at a higher bitrate. DJI lists 5 or 3 Mbps for Android and 2 or 1 Mbps for iOS.
Keep the phone's Wi-Fi strong. The stream travels from the phone over Wi-Fi to the computer; stay close to the router or hotspot.
Vertical for social. The Neo films landscape; Whole picture keeps the full frame with a blurred fill, Fill screen crops it.
Rehearse on the ground. Try with a video file in DJI Live Bridge checks the platform side before the Neo takes off.
DJI Fly cannot connect: check that the phone's Wi-Fi is on the computer's network, not on the Neo's own Wi-Fi.
No RTMP option: update DJI Fly and the Neo's firmware; the option depends on the DJI Fly version.
The picture stutters: the phone is too far from the router, or the network hops between 2.4 and 5 GHz.
Instagram rejects the stream: create a new live video on instagram.com and update the key; each key works once.

faq.q: Can the DJI Neo live stream?
faq.a: Yes, through RTMP in DJI Fly. For streaming to a computer, fly it with the RC-N3 or with goggles cabled to the phone, so the phone's Wi-Fi is free to join the computer's network.

faq.q: Can I live stream the Neo when controlling it with just my phone?
faq.a: Usually not to a computer: in that mode the phone's Wi-Fi is connected to the Neo. Some Android phones can share a hotspot at the same time, but we have not tested that.

faq.q: Can the DJI Neo stream to Instagram or TikTok?
faq.a: Not from DJI Fly directly. Send DJI Fly's RTMP stream to DJI Live Bridge, which forwards it to Instagram over RTMPS and to TikTok in vertical 1080×1920.

faq.q: Does it work with the Neo 2?
faq.a: If DJI Fly shows RTMP under Live Streaming Platforms for your drone and controller, it works: DJI Live Bridge only receives the RTMP stream and never talks to the drone.
